## `get_project_analyst`

*Available in [Python](#get_project_analyst-python), [CLI](#get_project_analyst-cli)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Retrieves the project analyst field of a CIDA project.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    get_project_analyst(
        project: CIDAProject
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project` (`CIDAProject`) - The CIDA project to retrieve the analyst for.

    <h4>Returns `None | str | list[str]`</h4>

    None
